scenes.hook: Why change encryption before a powerful enough quantum computer exists? Because some information must stay private for years.
scenes.idea: An attacker could record encrypted traffic now and hope to decrypt it later with future capabilities.
scenes.demo: Post quantum cryptography uses algorithms designed to resist known quantum attacks. It runs on ordinary computers.
scenes.compare: This does not mean every kind of encryption is already broken, or that a quantum laptop is required.
scenes.takeaway: Organizations are updating protocols and systems gradually. Long lived sensitive data is an important reason to prepare.
scenes.close: How long must data stay private? Subscribe to Tech at sixty for clear tech explainers.
